description:
The Cloud Data Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and securing Azure-based data platforms. This role builds and manages data pipelines, data storage solutions, data processing frameworks, and cloud infrastructure to support enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives.
 The engineer will work closely with business analysts, Power BI developers, DBAs, and infrastructure teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure data solutions.
  
 Data Pipeline Development 
 · Design, develop, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines.
 · Build automated batch and near real-time data integration processes.
 · Integrate data from on-premises and cloud systems.
 · Troubleshoot and optimize data workflows.
  
 Data Storage & Modeling 
 · Design and maintain data warehouse and data lake architectures.
 · Develop logical and physical data models.
 · Optimize database schemas, indexes, and partitioning strategies.
 · Support historical data retention and archival requirements.
  
 Azure Platform Administration 
 · Manage and support:
 Azure Data Factory (ADF)
 Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
 Azure SQL Database / Azure PostgreSQL
 Azure ExpressRoute
 Gateway Servers
 Monitoring & Logging Solutions
 · Configure networking, security groups, and access controls.
  
 Database Administration 
 · Database installation and configuration.
 · Performance tuning and query optimization.
 · Monitoring and maintenance.
 · Backup and recovery management.
 · High Availability (HA) and disaster recovery planning.
 · Replication and failover configuration.
  
 Infrastructure & Automation 
 · Develop scripts and automation for operational tasks.
 · Support CI/CD deployment processes.
 · Automate monitoring, alerting, and maintenance activities.
  
 Monitoring & Support 
 · Monitor platform availability and performance.
 · Resolve production incidents and root causes.
 · Maintain SLA and operational standards.
 · Provide technical support to business and development teams.
 · Complete tasks assigned by management.
  
  

        Azure Services 
 Azure Data Factory (ADF)
 Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
 Azure SQL Database
 Azure Database for PostgreSQL
 Azure ExpressRoute
 Azure Virtual Networks
  
       Data Technologies 
 SQL, Data Modeling, ETL / ELT, Data Warehousing
 Star Schema / Dimensional Modeling
  
        Scripting & Programming 
 Python, PowerShell, SQL T-SQL / PostgreSQL
  
 Preferred Qualifications 
 · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
 · 5+ years of Data Engineering experience.
 · 3+ years of Azure Cloud experience.
 · Experience with Power BI environments.
 · Experience migrating on-premises systems to Azure.
  
  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
